acceptance: to_detail_result passes compliance_class (and any other ranking inputs) to the peer entry
A test shows a non-standard bundle gets the same ranking_exclusion_reason in its manifest entry and its detail result
description: Defect: BundleTransformer.to_detail_result builds a ManifestEntry peer to compute ranking_exclusion_reason (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py:1796) but does not pass compliance_class, so for an unofficial_nonstandard bundle the detail record's ranking_exclusion_reason can differ from the manifest/ranking row (which reports unofficial_compliance). Found 2026-10-16 while reading the transformer for the subscale ranking change; left out of #3075 to keep it to the subscale policy. Pre-existing.
